description: The TryGhost preset automerges every update, but merging to main deploys the live site, so every Renovate PR here waits for a human.

packageRules.description: Override the preset's automerge for all dependencies and actions.
Keep the ^ ranges in package.json instead of the preset's exact-version pinning: in-range updates stay lockfile-only PRs, out-of-range ones widen the range.
